title: Seabiscuit Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: This 3 bedroom Charleston style cottage sleeps 10 and has undergone a full facelift in 2017.
description_expanded: Description750 FOREST STREET2 KING BEDS, 3 BUNK BEDS (sleeps 10) Classic Seaside Cottage in a Prime West Side LocationSeabiscuit is a beautifully updated Charleston-style cottage located in the heart of Seaside, Florida, offering the perfect blend of timeless coastal charm and modern comfort. Ideally situated just a 3-minute walk to the West Side family pool and a 4-minute walk (352 yards) to the private residential beach at Pensacola Pavilion, this inviting three-bedroom home comfortably sleeps up to ten guests and is ideal for families or groups seeking a classic Seaside experience.Expansive Porches & Outdoor Living SpacesUpon arrival, guests are greeted by private parking, a spacious side deck, and two full-length screened porches, one on each level of the home. The side deck features Adirondack seating for four, a large picnic table for outdoor dining, and a private enclosed outdoor shower, perfect for rinsing off after the beach.The lower screened porch offers a quintessential Seaside setting with charming artwork, a swinging bench, and comfortable club chairs—an ideal spot for morning coffee or winding down in the evening. Designed in a traditional dog trot-style layout, this porch provides direct access to the first-floor bedrooms, while the main living areas and primary suite are located upstairs.Comfortable Sleeping Arrangements for FamiliesThe first floor is thoughtfully designed for flexibility and function. At the front of the home, a bunk bedroom features one twin bed and a twin-over-double bunk, along with a dresser and wall-mounted flat-screen TV. Just outside the bedroom is a full hall bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination.Tucked into the hallway is a bonus bunk nook with a twin-over-twin bunk, each with its own mounted flat-screen TV—perfect for children or extra guests. At the rear of the home, a private king bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with an ensuite bathroom featuring a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and single vanity.Open-Concept Living & Entertaining UpstairsUpstairs, the second-floor screened porch serves as a guest favorite, expanding the living space with dining for eight, six rocking chairs, playful artwork, and soft ambient lighting—a relaxed, family-friendly space for meals and conversation.Inside, the open-concept living area features a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a large double-door refrigerator with ice and water dispenser, electric cooktop, microwave, coffee maker, and ample cookware. The adjacent dining area seats six to eight guests, with additional bar seating for three at the breakfast counter.The living room is designed for gathering, offering a large sectional sofa, two club chairs, and a mounted flat-screen TV—ideal for movie nights after a day at the beach. A convenient half bath serves the upstairs living spaces.Private Primary Suite & Rooftop Sunset ViewsLocated just off the upstairs living area, the spacious primary king suite provides a serene retreat with a flat-screen TV and a private screened porch featuring custom built-in bench seating and two club chairs. The renovated ensuite bathroom includes ample storage, a single vanity, and a large walk-in shower with dual shower heads.From the primary porch, a spiral staircase leads to a private rooftop deck, where guests can enjoy sweeping views of Seaside’s rooftops and breathtaking sunset vistas—an unforgettable way to end each day.For additional room, the one-bedroom guest house, Grace Sea (in the rear), may also be rented. Or the full 4 bedroom house, Sandy Toes, can be rented.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURESSeaside Private Residential Beach at Pensacola Pavilion3-minute walk (176 yards) to private beach accessTwo king bedroomsMedia and flat-screen TVs in every bedroomPrivate outdoor showerOutdoor charcoal grillPeacock Alley premium linens – fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the cottageLaundry room with full-size washer and dryerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets allowedSTR23-002092
